enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Close eyes. Roll onto the right side. Breathe slowly. Turn head to the left. Kick the blanket off the right foot. Roll onto the back. Place both arms on top of the blanket. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Bend the knees. Stretch the legs. Turn the head away from the pillow edge. Pull the pillow closer. Roll onto the back again. Place the right hand under the pillow. Remain lying still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Push the blanket aside. Swing both legs off the bed. Stand up from the bed. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Reach to the wall. Press the light switch on. Stand in front of the sink. Turn the tap handle. Let the water run. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water onto the face. Rub the face with both hands. Turn the tap off. Pick up the towel from the rack. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Turn the tap on again. Hold the toothbrush under the water. Turn the tap off. Pick up the toothpaste tube. Unscrew the cap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Put the cap back on. Put the toothpaste tube down. Lift the toothbrush to the mouth. Brush the upper teeth. Brush the lower teeth. Spit into the sink. Turn the tap on. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit again. Turn the tap off. Rinse the toothbrush under the water. Shake the toothbrush. Place the toothbrush back in the holder. Reach to the wall. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk to the kitchen counter. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton. Take out the eggs. Take out the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the cabinet door. Take out a bowl. Take out a plate. Close the cabinet door. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch on. Pick up two eggs. Crack the first egg on the edge of the bowl. Open the shell over the bowl. Crack the second egg. Open the shell over the bowl. Pick up a fork. Beat the eggs in the bowl. Pick up the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pan. Pour the beaten eggs into the pan. Stir the eggs with a spatula. Turn the eggs over. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto the plate. Pick up a slice of bread. Place it in the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Wait for the toast to pop up. Pick up the toast. Put it on the plate. Pour milk into a glass. Pick up the plate and the glass. Carry them to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Cut the eggs with the fork. Lift the food to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Pick up the glass. Drink the milk. Put the glass down. Stand up from the chair. Carry the plate and glass to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag for the clinical shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bedroom. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the work shirt. Take out the trousers. Take out the socks. Close the wardrobe door. Lay the clothes on the bed. Take off the sleepwear top. Take off the sleepwear bottom. Put on the work shirt. Button the shirt front. Put on the trousers. Pull the trousers up. Fasten the waistband. Sit on the bed. Put on the left sock. Put on the right sock. Stand up. Put on the left shoe. Tie the left shoelace. Put on the right shoe. Tie the right shoelace. Walk to the desk. Pick up the work bag. Open the bag zipper. Pick up the stethoscope from the desk. Place the stethoscope into the bag. Pick up the ID badge. Clip the badge onto the shirt collar. Pick up the phone from the desk. Place the phone into the bag pocket. Pick up the notebook. Place the notebook into the bag. Close the bag zipper. Lift the bag onto the shoulder. Walk out of the bedroom.

Walk out of the front door. Pull the door closed. Lock the door with the key. Put the key into the bag pocket. Walk down the stairs. Reach the ground floor. Push the building entrance door open. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the bag. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone back into the bag. Step onto the bus. Swipe the transit card on the reader. Walk along the aisle. Hold the handrail. Stand near the rear door. Shift weight as the bus moves. Take out the phone again. Scroll the phone screen. Put the phone back into the bag. Press the stop request button. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk. Cross the street at the crosswalk. Walk to the hospital entrance. Push the entrance door open. Walk to the staff room. Open the locker. Place the bag into the locker. Close the locker. Walk to the ward station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working clinical shift, providing patient care and updating medical records
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the ward station. Pick up the patient chart. Read the chart pages. Pick up the pen. Write notes on the chart. Put the pen down. Walk to the first patient room. Push the door open. Greet the patient. Say: Good morning, how are you feeling today? Pick up the blood pressure cuff. Wrap the cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the monitor display. Write the reading on the chart. Remove the cuff from the arm. Pick up the thermometer. Place the thermometer under the patient's tongue. Remove the thermometer. Read the temperature. Write it on the chart. Pick up the medication cup. Hand the cup to the patient. Hand the water cup to the patient. Take back the empty cups. Walk to the next patient room. Push the door open. Adjust the IV drip rate. Check the IV line. Replace the IV bag. Hang the new bag on the pole. Press the infusion pump buttons. Walk back to the ward station. Sit down at the computer. Type the patient notes into the system. Press the keyboard keys. Click the mouse to save the record. Stand up. Walk to the supply cabinet. Open the cabinet door. Take out the gauze packs. Close the cabinet door. Walk to the next patient room. Change the wound dressing. Peel the old dressing off. Wipe the wound with the swab. Place the new gauze. Fix the gauze with tape. Walk back to the ward station. Answer the phone at the desk. Say: Ward station, how can I help? Write down the message on the notepad.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff break room. Open the locker. Take out the lunch box. Close the locker. Walk to the microwave. Open the microwave door. Place the lunch box inside. Close the microwave door. Press the timer buttons. Press the start button. Wait for the microwave beep. Open the microwave door. Take out the lunch box. Close the microwave door. Walk to the table. Sit down on the chair. Open the lunch box lid. Pick up the fork. Lift the food to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Pick up the water bottle. Twist the cap open. Lift the bottle to the mouth. Drink the water. Twist the cap closed. Put the bottle down. Close the lunch box lid. Stand up. Carry the lunch box to the sink. Rinse the lunch box under the tap. Place the lunch box into the locker. Close the locker. Walk back to the ward station.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical shift, patient assessment and coordinating with care team
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the patient list from the desk. Walk to the first patient room. Push the door open. Ask the patient: How is the pain now? Press the abdomen with both hands. Release the hands. Write the assessment on the chart. Walk to the second patient room. Help the patient sit up in bed. Place the pillow behind the patient's back. Adjust the bed height with the remote. Press the bed control buttons. Walk to the nursing station. Sit down at the computer. Open the patient record file. Type the assessment notes. Click the mouse to submit. Stand up. Walk to the meeting room. Sit down at the table. Open the notebook. Join the care team handover. Say: Patient in room 3 needs a follow-up scan. Write the task on the notepad. Stand up. Walk back to the ward. Pick up the phone at the desk. Call the radiology department. Say: Please schedule a scan for room 3. Write the schedule time on the notepad. Walk to the supply room. Open the supply cabinet. Count the bandage boxes. Write the count on the inventory sheet. Take out two boxes of gloves. Close the cabinet door. Walk to the ward station. Place the gloves on the shelf. Sit down at the computer. Type the shift summary. Save the document. Stand up. Stretch both arms. Walk to the locker room.

Open the locker. Take out the bag. Close the locker. Walk to the staff room door. Push the door open. Walk along the corridor. Push the hospital entrance door open. Walk along the sidewalk. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the bag. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone back into the bag. Step onto the bus. Swipe the transit card on the reader. Hold the handrail. Stand near the rear door. Shift weight as the bus moves. Press the stop request button. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk. Cross the street at the crosswalk. Walk to the building entrance. Push the door open. Walk up the stairs. Take out the key. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the front door open. Step inside. Close the door. Lock the door. Take off the shoes. Place the shoes on the shoe rack. Walk to the bedroom.

Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the chicken. Take out the sauce bottle. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the cabinet door. Take out a cutting board. Take out a knife. Close the cabinet door. Place the cutting board on the counter. Pick up the vegetables. Rinse the vegetables under the tap. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Push the pieces to the side. Pick up the chicken. Cut the chicken into pieces. Pick up the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pan. Wait for the oil to heat. Pick up the chicken pieces. Place them into the pan. Stir with a spatula. Pour the sauce into the pan. Add the vegetables. Stir again. Sprinkle salt into the pan. Turn off the induction cooker. Pick up a plate. Slide the food onto the plate. Place the plate on the table. Place the cutting board into the sink. Rinse the knife. Place the knife on the rack.

Pull the chair out from the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Lift the food to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Pick up the spoon. Scoop the sauce. Lift the spoon to the mouth. Put the spoon down. Pick up the glass. Lift the glass to the mouth. Drink the water. Put the glass down. Pick up the fork again. Lift the food to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Push the plate slightly forward. Pick up the napkin. Wipe the mouth with the napkin. Put the napkin down. Stand up from the chair. Pick up the plate. Carry the plate to the sink. Pick up the glass. Carry the glass to the sink. Push the chair back under the table. Walk out of the kitchen.

Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote from the coffee table. Press the power button. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Lean back on the sofa. Cross the legs. Place the remote on the sofa armrest. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Look at the phone screen. Scroll the phone screen. Put the phone down on the coffee table. Pick up the remote again. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Shift position on the sofa. Reach for the cushion. Place the cushion behind the back. Lean back again. Pick up the glass from the coffee table. Drink water. Put the glass down. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to turn the TV off. Stand up from the sofa. Walk to the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry with the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Open the washing machine lid. Pick up the laundry basket. Take out the clothes. Sort the clothes into two piles. Place the light-colored clothes into the drum. Close the washing machine lid. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the power button on the washing machine. Press the program button. Press the start button. Stand by the machine. Listen for the water filling. Walk to the sink. Pick up the empty laundry basket. Place the basket on the floor. Open the cabinet door. Take out the fabric softener bottle. Open the bottle cap. Place the bottle on the shelf. Close the cabinet door. Walk back to the washing machine. Check the display panel. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review patient notes and complete continuing education modules
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Pull the chair out. Sit down on the chair. Press the computer power button. Wait for the screen to load. Move the mouse. Click the browser icon. Type the login information with the keyboard. Press the Enter key. Open the patient notes folder. Scroll the page with the mouse wheel. Read the notes on the screen. Pick up the pen. Write notes on the notepad. Put the pen down. Click the education module link. Read the module text. Click the next page button. Scroll down the page. Click the answer option. Click the submit button. Read the quiz result. Click the next module. Scroll the page. Click the play button on the video. Watch the video on the screen. Click the pause button. Pick up the water glass. Drink water. Put the glass down. Click the complete button. Click the logout button. Press the computer power button off. Stand up from the chair. Push the chair under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the living room and vacuuming
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the cushion from the sofa. Place the cushion on the sofa corner. Pick up the glass from the coffee table. Carry the glass to the kitchen. Place the glass on the counter. Walk back to the living room. Pick up the remote from the sofa. Place the remote in the drawer. Close the drawer. Pick up the magazines from the coffee table. Stack the magazines. Place the stack on the shelf. Pick up the vacuum cleaner from the corner. Unwind the power cord. Plug the cord into the wall socket. Press the power button on the vacuum cleaner. Push the vacuum head across the floor. Pull the vacuum head back. Move the head under the coffee table. Move the head along the sofa edge. Move the head to the corner. Press the power button off. Pull the plug from the socket. Wind the power cord around the hooks. Place the vacuum cleaner back in the corner. Straighten the sofa blanket with both hands. Walk to the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Push the door closed. Reach to the wall. Press the light switch on. Open the shower door. Turn the shower tap handle. Test the water temperature with the hand. Step into the shower. Stand under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Pour shampoo into the palm. Put the bottle down. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms. Rub the soap over the chest. Rinse the body under the water. Turn the shower tap handle off. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the rack. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Wrap the towel around the body. Open the cabinet door. Take out the sleepwear. Close the cabinet door. Put on the sleepwear top. Put on the sleepwear bottom. Hang the towel on the rack. Reach to the wall. Press the light switch off. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom. Walk to the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bed. Pull the blanket back. Sit down on the bed. Pick up the book from the nightstand. Open the book to the bookmark. Lie back on the bed. Prop the pillow behind the head. Hold the book with both hands. Turn the page. Read the page. Turn the next page. Read the next page. Close the book. Place the book on the nightstand. Reach to the desk lamp. Press the lamp switch off. Pull the blanket over the body. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Close eyes.

Lie still on the bed. Breathe slowly. Roll onto the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Bend the knees. Stretch the right leg. Roll onto the back. Place both arms on top of the blanket. Turn the head to the right. Turn the head to the left. Pull the pillow closer. Roll onto the right side. Tuck the hand under the cheek. Remain lying still. Keep eyes closed. Breathe steadily.
